newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim's Pride to buy Green Acres Foods.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim's Pride to buy Green Acres Foods.

text.p: Pilgrim's Pride Corp said Friday it has reached a definitive agreement to buy the Green Acres Foods chicken operation.
The company said it would pay cash and assume debt for the major assets of the operation, which is based in Nacogdoches and Center, Texas, and owned by Canadian investor Peter Pocklington.
A company official declined to give the value of the deal, which is to close April 4.
Pilgrim's Pride employs more than 11,250 people and operates poultry processing plants, distribution centers, hatcheries and feed mills in Texas, Arkansas, Arizona, Oklahoma and Mexico.
